narrative.executive_summary: Investigation surface exposes 6 MITRE ATT&CK technique(s) mapped across 3 tactic(s): **Execution** (1 tech.), **Defense Evasion** (4 tech.), **Command And Control** (1 tech.). The observed progression indicates active adversary tradecraft, prioritise containment against the highest-risk tactic first.
likely_objective: Execute attacker code on the endpoint
Evade EDR / AV detection
Maintain a channel to attacker infrastructure
recommended_actions: [Execution] Enable AMSI on all endpoints; enforce Constrained Language Mode for non-admin PowerShell; disable Office macros from the internet zone.
[Defense Evasion] Alert on any tampering with Defender, Sysmon, or EDR services; deploy tamper-protection where available.
[Command And Control] Block observed C2 IOCs at the proxy / firewall / DNS; hunt for other hosts beaconing to the same infrastructure.

[T1059.001] Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventID 4104) and Module Logging on all workstations; forward to SIEM and hunt for `IEX`, `Invoke-Expression`, `FromBase64String`, and `DownloadString` invocations.
[T1027] Alert on high-entropy PowerShell script blocks (>4.5 bits/char) and Base64 strings longer than 1 KB inside `-EncodedCommand` payloads.
[T1564.003] Detect PowerShell / cmd invocations with `-WindowStyle Hidden`, `-w hidden`, or `/min` — these are strong indicators of interactive malware execution.
[T1562.001] Alert on `Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring`, `sc stop WinDefend`, `reg add ... EnableLUA=0`, and any modification of `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender`.
[T1105] Block untrusted domains at proxy/DNS; hunt for `certutil -urlcache`, `bitsadmin /transfer`, `curl.exe`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, and `wget.exe` invocations from user workstations.
[IOC] Block or sink-hole the 1 observed URL indicator(s) at proxy/DNS.
sigma_hunts: Sigma: EventID 4104 script_block_text contains any of (`IEX`, `Invoke-Expression`, `DownloadString`, `FromBase64String`, `[Convert]::FromBase64String`)
Sigma: process powershell.exe command_line contains `-enc` OR `-encodedcommand` with base64 length > 1000
Sigma: process powershell.exe command_line contains any_of (`-w hidden`, `-windowstyle hidden`, `-noni -w hidden`)
Sigma: powershell Set-MpPreference OR reg.exe modifying `\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware`
Sigma: process any_of (`certutil.exe -urlcache`, `bitsadmin.exe /transfer`, `curl.exe`, `wget.exe`) OR powershell.exe with `Invoke-WebRequest`/`iwr`/`Net.WebClient`
